paragraphs.en: Other artists had big moments too. Record of the Year went to the 20-year-old Argentine singer Milo J for his song Niño, ahead of Rosalía, Karol G and others. Milo J won four trophies in the end and shouted out Argentine folk music. Puerto Rican reggaeton star Daddy Yankee was named Person of the Year, and Janet Jackson gave him a lifetime achievement award. Karol G won Best Urban Music Album for Tropicoqueta, and Aria Vega was named Best New Artist.

issues.title: American Cancer Society Now Urges Regular PSA Tests for Prostate Cancer
issues.gist: The American Cancer Society now recommends a PSA blood test every two years for average-risk men aged 50 to 69. Black men and men with a strong family history should start at 45 and test yearly.
issues.gistKo: 미국암학회가 평균 위험의 50~69세 남성에게 2년마다 PSA 혈액검사를 받으라고 권고해요. 흑인 남성과 가족력이 강한 남성은 45세에 시작해 해마다 검사해야 해요.
issues.easyKo: 2010년에는 의사와 상담해 보라는 정도였는데, 이제는 중년 남성에게 정기적인 전립선암 혈액검사를 직접 권해요. 다만 불필요한 치료 위험 때문에 다른 의학 단체들은 아직 조심스러워요.

views.view: It calls this the most specific guideline yet, and it lists groups that disagree about PSA testing.
It says the change takes away doubt for doctors, and it quotes a specialist who welcomes the clear advice.
It says the new steps, such as a repeat test and MRI, aim to cut unnecessary biopsies and overtreatment.
It says stronger evidence shows PSA screening lowers deaths from prostate cancer and advanced diagnoses.

why: The ACS says new evidence shows PSA testing can save lives, and better follow-up steps can reduce harm.
Past worries about false alarms and needless treatment shaped the old, softer advice.
lines.agree: Reports agree that the ACS now directly recommends PSA tests every two years for average-risk men aged 50 to 69.
lines.split: Other groups, such as the US task force, still prefer individual decisions, and one family doctors' group does not recommend PSA screening.
lines.life: Students are far younger than these ages, but they can ask about family history and see how medical advice changes with evidence.

talk.q: Why do medical guidelines sometimes change over time?
talk.qKo: 의학 지침은 왜 시간이 지나며 바뀔 때가 있을까요?
talk.answer: In this story, the ACS changed its advice because new evidence showed PSA tests can lower deaths. I think it is good when experts update advice after new research. But people should still talk with a doctor about benefits and risks.
talk.answerKo: 이 이야기에서 ACS는 PSA 검사가 사망을 줄일 수 있다는 새 증거가 나와서 권고를 바꿨어요. 전문가들이 새 연구 뒤에 권고를 고치는 것은 좋은 일이라고 생각해요. 그래도 이익과 위험을 의사와 상담해야 해요.

paragraphs.en: The American Cancer Society, or ACS, released an updated prostate cancer screening guideline on Thursday, November 12. It now directly recommends a PSA blood test every two years for men at average risk, from age 50 to 69. Black men and men with a strong family history should start at age 45 and get tested every year. The old guideline from 2010 only said most men should talk with a doctor about testing. The ACS says an estimated 333,830 men will be diagnosed in the United States in 2026, and 36,320 will die.
paragraphs.ko: 미국암학회(ACS)가 11월 12일 목요일에 전립선암 검진 지침을 새로 내놓았어요. 이제 평균 위험의 남성에게 50세부터 69세까지 2년마다 PSA 혈액검사를 받으라고 직접 권고해요. 흑인 남성과 가족력이 강한 남성은 45세에 시작해 해마다 검사를 받아야 해요. 2010년의 옛 지침은 대부분의 남성이 검사에 대해 의사와 상담하라고만 했어요. ACS는 2026년 미국에서 약 33만 3,830명이 진단받고 3만 6,320명이 숨질 것으로 추정해요.

sents.en: The American Cancer Society, or ACS, released an updated prostate cancer screening guideline on Thursday, November 12.

sents.ko: ACS는 2026년 미국에서 약 33만 3,830명이 진단받고 3만 6,320명이 숨질 것으로 추정해요.

paragraphs.en: The ACS says the evidence is now stronger that PSA screening lowers deaths and advanced-stage diagnoses. PSA is a protein made by normal and cancer cells in the prostate, so a high level does not always mean cancer. To limit harm, the guideline says to repeat a high result and then use an MRI scan or a biomarker test before a biopsy. A PSA level of 3.0 ng/mL or higher counts as high for men aged 45 to 69. For slow-growing tumors, doctors can use active surveillance, which means watching closely instead of treating right away.
paragraphs.ko: ACS는 PSA 검진이 사망과 진행된 단계의 진단을 줄인다는 증거가 이제 더 강해졌다고 말해요. PSA는 전립선의 정상 세포와 암세포가 만드는 단백질이라서, 수치가 높다고 늘 암은 아니에요. 피해를 줄이려고 지침은 높게 나온 결과를 다시 재고, 조직검사 전에 MRI나 바이오마커 검사를 하라고 해요. 45세에서 69세 남성은 PSA가 3.0 ng/mL 이상이면 높은 것으로 봐요. 천천히 자라는 종양은 바로 치료하지 않고 면밀히 지켜보는 적극적 감시를 쓸 수 있어요.

sents.en: To limit harm, the guideline says to repeat a high result and then use an MRI scan or a biomarker test before a biopsy.
sents.ko: 피해를 줄이려고 지침은 높게 나온 결과를 다시 재고, 조직검사 전에 MRI나 바이오마커 검사를 하라고 해요.

sents.en: A PSA level of 3.0 ng/mL or higher counts as high for men aged 45 to 69.
sents.ko: 45세에서 69세 남성은 PSA가 3.0 ng/mL 이상이면 높은 것으로 봐요.

sents.en: For slow-growing tumors, doctors can use active surveillance, which means watching closely instead of treating right away.
sents.ko: 천천히 자라는 종양은 바로 치료하지 않고 면밀히 지켜보는 적극적 감시를 쓸 수 있어요.

paragraphs.en: Dr. Ash Tewari, a urologist at Mount Sinai, said the update removes confusion for primary care doctors. James Eastham of Memorial Sloan Kettering called it a balanced approach because it limits unnecessary biopsies. Other groups do not fully agree, and the US Preventive Services Task Force still advises individual decisions about PSA tests. ABC News reports that the American Academy of Family Physicians does not recommend PSA screening at all. PSA testing can cause false alarms and treatment that is not needed, and some treatments can cause urinary or bowel problems.
paragraphs.ko: 마운트시나이의 비뇨기과 의사 애시 테와리는 이번 개정이 1차 진료 의사들의 혼란을 없앤다고 말했어요. 메모리얼 슬론 케터링의 제임스 이스텀은 불필요한 조직검사를 줄이므로 균형 잡힌 접근이라고 했어요. 다른 단체들은 완전히 같은 생각은 아니고, 미국 예방서비스 태스크포스는 여전히 PSA 검사를 개인이 정하라고 권해요. ABC뉴스에 따르면 미국가정의학회는 PSA 검진을 아예 권하지 않아요. PSA 검사는 잘못된 경보와 필요 없는 치료로 이어질 수 있고, 일부 치료는 배뇨나 배변 문제를 일으킬 수 있어요.

paragraphs.en: Most university students are much younger than the ages in this guideline, so it does not apply to them yet. But many students have fathers, uncles or grandfathers in these age groups. For students in health fields, it is a clear example of experts weighing benefits against harms.

issues.title: COP31 Opens in Turkey as the 1.5 Degree Goal Slips Away
issues.gist: At the COP31 climate summit in Turkey, leaders admit that the 1.5 degree goal is almost out of reach. A new report says current policies lead to about 2.7 degrees of warming by 2100.
issues.gistKo: 튀르키예에서 열린 COP31에서 정상들은 1.5도 목표가 거의 불가능해졌다고 인정하고 있어요. 새 보고서는 현재 정책대로면 2100년까지 약 2.7도 오른다고 해요.
issues.easyKo: 기후 정상회의가 열렸지만 지구 기온 상승을 1.5도로 막는 건 사실상 어려워졌어요. 이제는 얼마나 더 오를지를 줄이는 데 힘을 모으자는 이야기가 커지고 있어요.

glosses.meaning: 기후행동추적(각국 기후 정책을 평가하는 연구 모임)
빙하(얼음이 쌓여 천천히 흐르는 큰 얼음덩어리)

views.view: It reports Burnham's promise of British leadership and says campaigners want stronger action to match his words.
It reports Thunberg's warning, and says China will not host COP33 in 2028, which disappoints many experts.
It says the 1.5 degree goal is effectively dead and that diplomats lament the sudden setback.
It says warming under current policies is about 2.7 degrees and that overshoot of 1.5 degrees is largely unavoidable.

why: The 1.5 degree goal now looks out of reach, so talks are shifting to limiting how far and how long temperatures overshoot.
Leaders are split between warm words and slow action, while the US is absent.
lines.agree: Reports agree that the 1.5 degree goal is slipping away and that progress on cutting emissions is too slow.
lines.split: Some praise Burnham's attendance and the electrification push, while others say words are not enough without real action.
lines.life: Heat waves, food prices and green jobs for Korean students depend on how fast countries cut emissions, and Korea may bid to host COP33.
lines.next: Watch the electrification deal and whether any Asian country, such as South Korea, bids for COP33.

quiz.why: 1문단: “current policies lead to about 2.7 degrees of warming by 2100”

quiz.qKo: COP33 소식이 한국에 중요한 까닭은 무엇인가요?
choices: Korea has already been chosen as host
Korea must leave the UN climate talks

quiz.why: 4문단: “South Korea is among the countries thinking about a bid”

issues.job: COP31과 1.5도 목표 이야기 = 「기후 정책 · 에너지 전환」 질문에 쓸 수 있어요. 각국의 약속과 실행의 차이를 설명하는 사례로 말할 수 있어요.

talk.q: Should South Korea try to host a future UN climate summit?
talk.qKo: 한국이 앞으로 유엔 기후 정상회의를 유치해야 한다고 생각하나요?
talk.answer: I think it could be a good chance for Korea. Hosting would show that Korea takes the climate seriously, and it could attract green industries. But the country would need to show real progress on cutting emissions first.
talk.answerKo: 한국에 좋은 기회가 될 수 있다고 생각해요. 개최하면 한국이 기후 문제를 진지하게 본다는 점을 보여 주고 친환경 산업도 끌어올 수 있어요. 다만 먼저 온실가스 감축에서 실제 성과를 보여야 해요.

paragraphs.en: The COP31 climate summit is being held in Antalya, Turkey, and it is co-hosted by Turkey and Australia. Many leaders and campaigners say the talks come at a hard time, because hopes for the 1.5 degree goal of the Paris Agreement are fading. Chris Bowen, Australia's climate minister, said the world has no chance of holding to 1.5 degrees, according to the New York Times. A new report from Climate Action Tracker says current policies lead to about 2.7 degrees of warming by 2100. If all pledges and long-term targets are met, the figure would be 2.1 degrees.
paragraphs.ko: COP31 기후 정상회의가 튀르키예 안탈리아에서 열리고 있고, 튀르키예와 호주가 공동으로 이끌어요. 파리협정의 1.5도 목표에 대한 기대가 꺼지고 있어서, 많은 정상과 활동가는 회담이 어려운 시기에 열린다고 말해요. 뉴욕타임스에 따르면 호주의 기후 장관 크리스 보언은 세계가 1.5도를 지킬 가능성이 없다고 말했어요. 기후행동추적(Climate Action Tracker)의 새 보고서는 현재 정책대로면 2100년까지 약 2.7도 오른다고 해요. 모든 약속과 장기 목표가 지켜지면 수치는 2.1도가 돼요.

paragraphs.en: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham was the only G7 leader to attend the summit. He said the old consensus on science and climate has gone, but he promised a new era of British leadership and created a climate security envoy. Turkey wants countries to agree that electricity should meet 35 percent of energy supply by 2035, up from about a fifth today. Swedish activist Greta Thunberg told the summit that the planet is not dying but is being killed. The United States has been absent from the climate talks since President Trump withdrew from the Paris Agreement.
paragraphs.ko: 영국의 앤디 번햄 총리는 G7 정상 가운데 이 회의에 참석한 유일한 사람이었어요. 그는 과학과 기후에 대한 예전의 공감대가 사라졌다고 말하면서도, 영국이 새로운 지도력의 시대를 열겠다고 약속하고 기후 안보 특사를 만들었어요. 튀르키예는 2035년까지 전기가 에너지 공급의 35%를 맡도록 각국이 합의하길 바라는데, 지금은 약 5분의 1이에요. 스웨덴 활동가 그레타 툰베리는 지구가 죽어 가는 것이 아니라 죽임을 당하고 있다고 회의에서 말했어요. 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 파리협정에서 탈퇴한 뒤 미국은 이 기후 회담에 계속 빠져 있어요.

issues.title: Crow-Armstrong and Alvarez Win Unanimous MVP Awards in Major League Baseball
issues.gist: Pete Crow-Armstrong of the Cubs and Yordan Alvarez of the Astros won unanimous MVP awards in their leagues. It is the first year in which both MVPs and both Cy Young winners were unanimous.
issues.gistKo: 컵스의 피트 크로 암스트롱과 애스트로스의 요르단 알바레스가 각 리그에서 만장일치 MVP에 올랐어요. 두 MVP와 두 사이영상 수상자가 모두 만장일치인 것은 올해가 처음이에요.
issues.easyKo: 메이저리그 MVP 두 명이 모두 한 표도 빠짐없이 1위표를 받았어요. 사이영상까지 합쳐 네 개 주요 상이 전부 만장일치였던 건 처음이에요.

views.view: It calls the awards a historic sweep and says Crow-Armstrong led both leagues with 10.6 fWAR.
It says Crow-Armstrong thinks he can do better in big moments, since he went 0-for-7 in the playoffs.
It stresses Alvarez's historic season, with a .432 on-base percentage and 1.033 OPS leading the league.

heads.title: Cubs' Crow-Armstrong, Astros' Alvarez sweep votes as unanimous MVP winners

why: Both MVP votes were unanimous, and the two Cy Young votes were too, which has never happened before.
The new MVPs follow Ohtani and Judge, who won in 2024.
lines.agree: Reports agree that Crow-Armstrong and Alvarez won MVP by unanimous vote after strong, healthy seasons.
lines.life: Korean fans who follow MLB can use these numbers to learn how walks, speed and defense add up to value.
lines.next: Watch the offseason to see whether the two MVPs can repeat, and whether Crow-Armstrong improves in the playoffs.

paragraphs.en: Two players won the Most Valuable Player award in Major League Baseball on Thursday night, and both votes were unanimous. Pete Crow-Armstrong of the Chicago Cubs took the National League award with all 30 first-place votes. Shohei Ohtani, a four-time MVP, finished second, and Brice Turang of the Brewers was third. Yordan Alvarez of the Houston Astros won the American League award, ahead of Junior Caminero and Bobby Witt Jr.
paragraphs.ko: 목요일 밤 메이저리그 최우수선수(MVP) 두 명이 발표됐고, 두 투표 모두 만장일치였어요. 시카고 컵스의 피트 크로 암스트롱이 30표 모두 1위표를 받아 내셔널리그 MVP를 차지했어요. MVP를 네 번 받은 오타니 쇼헤이가 2위, 브루어스의 브라이스 투랑이 3위였어요. 휴스턴 애스트로스의 요르단 알바레스는 주니어 카미네로와 바비 위트 주니어를 제치고 아메리칸리그 MVP에 올랐어요.

sents.en: Pete Crow-Armstrong of the Chicago Cubs took the National League award with all 30 first-place votes.

paragraphs.en: Crow-Armstrong, 24, hit .280 with 45 home runs and 41 stolen bases, and he also won the Gold Glove for his defense. His start was slow, and he batted ninth in the lineup early in the season. In mid-May, the team moved him to the leadoff spot to give the offense a spark, and he took off. He hit .300 as a leadoff man and drew 83 walks, compared with only 29 the year before. He also led both leagues with a 10.6 fWAR, a stat that measures a player's total value.
paragraphs.ko: 24세의 크로 암스트롱은 타율 0.280에 홈런 45개, 도루 41개를 기록했고 수비로 골드글러브도 받았어요. 시즌 초반에는 부진해서 타순 9번에 들어갔어요. 5월 중순 팀이 공격에 불을 붙이려고 그를 1번 타자로 옮기자 그는 날아올랐어요. 1번 타자로는 타율 0.300을 쳤고 볼넷 83개를 얻었는데, 전년도에는 29개뿐이었어요. 그는 선수의 전체 가치를 재는 기록인 fWAR에서도 10.6으로 두 리그를 통틀어 1위였어요.

paragraphs.en: Alvarez, 29, almost won the triple crown, leading the league with a .316 average and finishing second in home runs and RBIs. He played only 48 games in 2025 because of a wrist fracture and a sprained ankle, but this year he played 158. When asked what changed, he said simply, "I was healthy." The week had more history, because Jacob Misiorowski of the Brewers and Cam Schlittler of the Yankees won unanimous Cy Young awards. It is the first season in which both MVPs and both Cy Young winners were unanimous.

paragraphs.en: Even after winning, Crow-Armstrong said he wants to do better in big moments, such as the playoffs. He went 0-for-7 in the postseason this year. issues.title: Indonesia's Vice President Gibran Resigns Over Questions About His School Diploma
issues.gist: Indonesia's vice president, Gibran Rakabuming Raka, resigned after a court said there was no convincing proof that he finished high school. Analysts say the move also shows a split between President Prabowo and former president Jokowi.

heads.title: Did Indonesia’s vice-president just resign because he didn’t have a high school diploma?
Indonesia’s Vice President, Gibran, Resigns
Indonesia’s Prabowo rushes end of Jokowi era with son’s ouster

views.view: It says the school ruling is only the surface and the deeper cause is the breakdown of the alliance between Prabowo and Jokowi.
It quotes analysts who say the relationship has fractured and that Prabowo wants to step out of Jokowi's shadow.
It reports an analyst's view that Prabowo's real target may be Jokowi, and that Prabowo now controls the shortlist for the next vice president.

why: A court said there was no convincing proof that the vice president finished high school, and parliament was moving toward impeachment.
Many analysts also see a power struggle between President Prabowo and former president Jokowi.
lines.agree: Reports agree that Gibran resigned, that his school credentials were questioned, and that a new vice president must be chosen within 60 days.
lines.split: Some stress the diploma ruling, while others say the real story is the broken alliance between Prabowo and Jokowi.
lines.life: Students can use this to see how a leader's qualifications and family politics can shake a government in a major Asian economy.
lines.next: Watch who Prabowo nominates as the new vice president and how Jokowi's camp reacts.

paragraphs.en: Indonesia's vice president, 39-year-old Gibran Rakabuming Raka, has resigned after months of questions about his education. He is the eldest son of former president Joko Widodo, who is widely known as Jokowi. He was elected in 2024 as the country's youngest vice president. This week he offered to step down, and the news said he handed his resignation to Parliament on Thursday. President Prabowo Subianto accepted it at a news conference at the Merdeka palace in Jakarta.
paragraphs.ko: 인도네시아의 39세 지브란 라카부밍 라카 부통령이 몇 달간의 학력 논란 끝에 사임했어요. 그는 흔히 조코위로 불리는 조코 위도도 전 대통령의 맏아들이에요. 그는 2024년에 나라에서 가장 젊은 부통령으로 뽑혔어요. 이번 주 그는 물러나겠다고 했고, 보도에 따르면 목요일 의회에 사임서를 냈어요. 프라보워 수비안토 대통령은 자카르타 므르데카 궁의 기자회견에서 사임을 받아들였어요.

paragraphs.en: The trigger was a ruling by the constitutional court last month. The court said there was no convincing evidence that Gibran had a certificate or degree from abroad showing he finished high school. Indonesian law says a candidate needs a high school certificate, but the court could not cancel the 2024 election result. Gibran attended a school in Singapore and a college in Australia, and he earned a bachelor's degree through an institute in Singapore. After the ruling, parliament pushed harder to impeach him. Questions about him were not new, because a court had earlier made a last-minute exception to the age limit so that candidates under 40 could run.
paragraphs.ko: 계기는 지난달 헌법재판소의 판결이었어요. 재판소는 지브란이 고등학교를 마쳤음을 보여 줄 해외 졸업장이나 학위가 있다는 확실한 증거가 없다고 했어요. 인도네시아 법은 후보에게 고등학교 졸업장을 요구하지만, 재판소는 2024년 선거 결과를 무효로 할 수는 없었어요. 지브란은 싱가포르의 학교와 호주의 대학 과정에 다녔고, 싱가포르의 한 교육기관을 통해 학사 학위를 받았어요. 판결 뒤 의회는 그를 탄핵하려는 움직임을 더 세게 밀어붙였어요. 그를 둘러싼 의문은 새롭지 않았어요. 앞서 법원이 40세 미만도 출마할 수 있게 막판에 나이 제한의 예외를 만들었기 때문이에요.

paragraphs.en: Analysts say the school question is only part of the story. Yoes Kenawas of the Indonesian Survey Institute said the relationship between the two leaders has clearly fractured. He added that Prabowo is trying to show he has stepped out of Jokowi's shadow. Law lecturer Titi Anggraini said Gibran was brought in mainly as a vote-getter. Researcher Made Supriatma said the real target may be Jokowi himself, because only Jokowi could challenge Prabowo. Analyst Kennedy Muslim warned that this may not be a one-off, since Prabowo's popularity fell to 44.5 percent in October from 81.2 percent a year earlier.
paragraphs.ko: 분석가들은 학력 문제가 이야기의 일부일 뿐이라고 말해요. 인도네시아서베이연구소의 요에스 케나와스는 두 지도자의 관계가 분명히 갈라졌다고 말했어요. 그는 프라보워가 조코위의 그늘에서 벗어났다는 것을 보여 주려 한다고 덧붙였어요. 법학 강사 티티 앙그라이니는 지브란이 주로 표를 모으는 사람으로 영입됐다고 했어요. 연구자 마데 수프리아트마는 프라보워에게 맞설 사람은 조코위뿐이라서 진짜 겨냥 대상이 조코위일 수 있다고 했어요. 분석가 케네디 무슬림은 프라보워의 지지율이 1년 전 81.2%에서 10월 44.5%로 떨어졌기 때문에 일회성이 아닐 수 있다고 경고했어요.

paragraphs.en: Other tensions add to the picture. Last week it was alleged that Prabowo's chief of staff had wiretapped the president's phone, and police said they were investigating treason charges against four suspects. The chief of staff has not commented publicly. Prabowo also faces street protests, economic trouble and unhappiness about policies such as his free meals program. For students in Korea, the story is a reminder that rules about a leader's qualifications can shake a whole government. Indonesia is also Southeast Asia's largest economy, so political uncertainty there can matter to investors.

sents.en: Other tensions add to the picture.
sents.ko: 다른 갈등도 있어요.

sents.en: Last week it was alleged that Prabowo's chief of staff had wiretapped the president's phone, and police said they were investigating treason charges against four suspects.

sents.en: The chief of staff has not commented publicly.
sents.ko: 비서실장은 공개적으로 입장을 밝히지 않았어요.

sents.en: Prabowo also faces street protests, economic trouble and unhappiness about policies such as his free meals program.
sents.ko: 프라보워는 거리 시위, 경제 불안, 무상 급식 같은 정책에 대한 불만도 마주하고 있어요.

Analysts say this gives Prabowo more control over who holds the post and over the race for 2029. Analysts also warn that more power in one place can bring more anger toward the president. Watch who is nominated and how Jokowi's camp reacts.
paragraphs.ko: 다음으로 60일 안에 새 부통령을 뽑아야 해요. 상원 격인 국민협의회가 대통령이 추천하는 두 이름 가운데에서 고르게 돼요. 분석가들은 이것이 누가 그 자리에 앉을지, 그리고 2029년 선거전에서 프라보워에게 더 큰 통제력을 준다고 말해요. 분석가들은 권력이 한곳에 모일수록 대통령에게 쏠리는 불만도 커질 수 있다고 경고해요. 누가 후보로 오르는지, 조코위 진영이 어떻게 반응하는지 지켜보세요.

issues.title: Hegseth Gives a Medal to the Guard Who Told His Group to Be Quiet at Arlington
issues.gist: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth gave a medal to a soldier who scolded his group for noise at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. The Pentagon says the soldier was right to remind everyone to show respect.
issues.gistKo: 피트 헤그세스 미국 국방장관이 무명용사의 묘에서 자기 일행의 소음을 꾸짖은 병사에게 훈장을 줬어요. 국방부는 병사가 모두에게 예의를 지키라고 한 것이 옳았다고 해요.
issues.easyKo: 재향군인의 날 알링턴 국립묘지에서 경비병이 장관 일행에게 조용히 하라고 외쳤어요. 이튿날 장관은 그 병사에게 훈장을 달아 줬어요. 국방부는 병사가 옳았다고 했어요.

heads.title: Hegseth awards medal to soldier who reprimanded group near tomb

views.view: It reports the medal and the Pentagon's words that the soldier correctly and respectfully reminded everyone, and says such reminders are not unusual.
It calls Hegseth embattled, links the story to the failed impeachment attempt and the Iran war, and notes the medal is rarely given to junior soldiers.
It explains the tradition of decorum at the tomb and reports that Trump praised Hegseth at the same Veterans Day event.

why: A guard at one of America's most sacred memorials corrected the defense secretary's group, and the secretary then gave him a top medal.
The story is watched closely because Hegseth is already under pressure over the Iran war.
lines.agree: Reports agree that Spc. Iglesias told the group to be quiet and that Hegseth gave him the Joint Service Commendation Medal the next day.
lines.life: Students can see how a public correction is handled and why respect rules at memorials apply to everyone.
lines.next: Watch whether attention returns to the Iran war debate and the impeachment effort in Congress.

issues.job: 공개 석상에서 지적받은 지도자가 어떻게 반응하는지 = 「위기 소통 · 조직 문화」 질문에 쓸 수 있어요.

talk.q: How should a leader react when someone corrects them in public?
talk.qKo: 누군가 공개적으로 지적할 때 지도자는 어떻게 반응해야 할까요?
talk.answer: In this story, a guard told the defense secretary's group to be quiet, and the secretary later praised him. I think a leader should accept a fair correction quickly. It shows respect for the rules and for other people.
talk.answerKo: 이 이야기에서 경비병이 국방장관 일행에게 조용히 하라고 했고, 장관은 나중에 그를 칭찬했어요. 지도자는 정당한 지적을 빨리 받아들여야 한다고 생각해요. 규칙과 다른 사람에 대한 존중을 보여 주니까요.

paragraphs.en: On Veterans Day, Wednesday, November 11, a video from Arlington National Cemetery spread widely online. It showed US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, his wife and other aides posing for photos near the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. Someone in the group laughed, and the soldier on guard, Spc. Thomas Iglesias, shouted that all visitors must keep an atmosphere of silence and respect. The tomb is one of the most sacred war memorials in the United States.
paragraphs.ko: 재향군인의 날인 11월 11일 수요일, 알링턴 국립묘지에서 찍힌 영상이 온라인에 널리 퍼졌어요. 영상에는 피트 헤그세스 국방장관과 그의 아내, 보좌진이 무명용사의 묘 근처에서 사진을 찍는 모습이 담겼어요. 일행 중 누군가가 웃었고, 근무 중이던 토머스 이글레시아스 병장은 모든 방문객이 침묵과 존중의 분위기를 지켜야 한다고 외쳤어요. 이 묘는 미국에서 가장 신성한 전쟁 기념물 가운데 하나예요.

sents.en: On Veterans Day, Wednesday, November 11, a video from Arlington National Cemetery spread widely online.

paragraphs.en: On Thursday, Hegseth gave Iglesias the Joint Service Commendation Medal at the Pentagon. Soldiers from the 3rd US Infantry Regiment, known as the Old Guard, were there too. Hegseth posted photos on X and wrote that he loves soldiers and loves standards. The Pentagon said the medal was for his duties at the tomb on November 11. Spokesman Sean Parnell said the soldier correctly and respectfully reminded everyone to keep decorum. DW notes that this medal is seen as one of the military's top awards and is not usually given to junior enlisted soldiers.
paragraphs.ko: 목요일 헤그세스는 국방부에서 이글레시아스에게 합동군 표창 훈장을 줬어요. "올드 가드"로 불리는 미 육군 제3보병연대 병사들도 함께했어요. 헤그세스는 X에 사진을 올리고 병사와 기준을 사랑한다고 썼어요. 국방부는 훈장이 11월 11일 묘에서 한 임무에 대한 것이라고 했어요. 숀 파넬 대변인은 병사가 모두에게 예의를 지키라고 올바르고 정중하게 일깨웠다고 말했어요. DW는 이 훈장이 군의 최고급 상으로 여겨지고 하급 사병에게는 보통 주지 않는다고 짚었어요.

paragraphs.en: Coverage mostly describes the facts and keeps a neutral tone. CBS News says it is not unusual for guards to remind visitors to keep order, and one soldier said it happens two or three times a day. BBC explains that cemetery rules ask visitors to speak quietly and avoid disrespectful behavior. DW describes Hegseth as an embattled defense secretary who is under fire over the Iran war. All three reports I read quote the Pentagon saying the soldier was right to remind everyone.
paragraphs.ko: 보도는 대체로 사실을 전하며 중립적인 어조를 유지해요. CBS 뉴스는 경비병이 방문객에게 질서를 지키라고 일깨우는 일이 드물지 않으며, 한 병사는 하루 두세 번 있는 일이라고 했다고 전해요. BBC는 묘지 규칙이 방문객에게 조용히 말하고 무례한 행동을 피하라고 요구한다고 설명해요. DW는 헤그세스를 이란 전쟁 때문에 비판받는 궁지에 몰린 국방장관으로 묘사해요. 제가 읽은 세 보도 모두 병사가 모두에게 일깨운 것이 옳았다는 국방부의 말을 인용해요.

paragraphs.en: The timing matters because Hegseth is already in the news. On Tuesday, an effort in Congress to impeach him over his handling of the war with Iran failed. Hegseth called the effort a farce and a stunt. President Donald Trump has also pointed to the war as a major reason for his party's losses in last week's midterm elections, DW reports. At the Veterans Day ceremony, Trump praised Hegseth for doing a fantastic job.
paragraphs.ko: 시기가 눈에 띄는 것은 헤그세스가 이미 뉴스에 오르내리고 있기 때문이에요. 화요일 의회에서 이란 전쟁 대응을 이유로 그를 탄핵하려던 시도가 무산됐어요. 헤그세스는 그 시도를 소극이자 쇼라고 불렀어요. DW에 따르면 도널드 트럼프 대통령도 지난주 중간선거에서 자기 당이 패한 큰 이유로 그 전쟁을 꼽았어요. 재향군인의 날 행사에서 트럼프는 헤그세스가 아주 훌륭히 일하고 있다고 칭찬했어요.

sents.en: On Tuesday, an effort in Congress to impeach him over his handling of the war with Iran failed.

sents.en: Hegseth called the effort a farce and a stunt.
sents.ko: 헤그세스는 그 시도를 소극이자 쇼라고 불렀어요.

sents.en: President Donald Trump has also pointed to the war as a major reason for his party's losses in last week's midterm elections, DW reports.

sents.en: At the Veterans Day ceremony, Trump praised Hegseth for doing a fantastic job.

paragraphs.en: For students, the story is a small example of how leaders respond when they are corrected in public. It also shows that rules of respect at memorials apply to everyone, including top officials. Next, watch whether the focus returns to the Iran war debate in Congress.

issues.title: AI Data Center Spending Soars as Voters and Investors Push Back
issues.gist: SpaceX plans $74 billion for new data centers, and Nebius plans $40 billion in 2027 spending. At the same time, voters in at least 38 places in the US voted to limit data centers.
issues.gistKo: 스페이스X는 새 데이터센터에 740억 달러를 쓰겠다고 했고, 네비우스는 2027년에 400억 달러를 쓰겠다고 했어요. 한편 미국 최소 38곳에서 주민들이 데이터센터를 제한하기로 투표했어요.
issues.easyKo: AI를 돌리는 큰 건물인 데이터센터에 엄청난 돈이 몰리고 있어요. 그런데 전기와 환경 걱정 때문에 주민 반대도 커지고 있어요.

views.view: It reports SpaceX's $74 billion plan and says its AI computing business now brings in over half its revenue.
It warns that Nebius's $40 billion plan rests on projects that are already showing delays.
It says SoftBank's over-order of power turbines turned into a loss, though demand for AI power remains large.
It says Cerebras shares jumped after a surprise profit, easing worries about AI spending.
It finds that half or more of US adults see data centers as mostly bad for the environment and energy costs.
It presents a Swedish wooden data center with renewable power as a model that locals can accept.

heads.title: SpaceX Plans $74 Billion Investment to Build Data Centers in Texas and Arizona
Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
Cerebras shares surge as profit surprise, forecast raise ease AI spending worries
Datacentres are deeply unpopular. Has Sweden made one we can all love?
Data Centers Will Continue to Be Built, Despite Midterm Elections

why: AI needs huge buildings full of computers, and companies are spending tens of billions of dollars on them.
Local anger about power, water and noise is growing, so these plans face more votes and permits.
lines.agree: Reports agree that data center spending is rising fast and that it is now a topic for voters, not only for tech firms.
lines.split: Backers point to jobs and AI growth, while critics point to the environment and energy costs; surveys show mixed views on jobs.
lines.life: Students using AI tools can see that every chatbot depends on power and land, which may touch local bills and careers in energy or data.
lines.next: Watch whether Arizona approves SpaceX's campus and whether Nebius and other firms can finish projects on time.

talk.answer: In this story, builders promise jobs, but many people worry about power, water and costs. I think a town should ask for clear information first. Renewable power and community talks can make the plan fairer.
talk.answerKo: 이 이야기에서 건설사는 일자리를 약속하지만 많은 사람은 전력, 물, 비용을 걱정해요. 마을이 먼저 분명한 정보를 요구해야 한다고 생각해요. 재생에너지와 주민 대화가 계획을 더 공정하게 만들 수 있어요.

paragraphs.en: SpaceX said on Thursday that it plans to invest $74 billion in new data center campuses in Texas and Arizona. The Texas site near its Starbase rocket base would cost $24 billion and make its own power. The Arizona campus would cost $50 billion and still needs approval from the county. Nebius, a young cloud company, also laid out $40 billion in planned spending for 2027.
paragraphs.ko: 스페이스X는 목요일 텍사스와 애리조나에 새 데이터센터 단지를 짓는 데 740억 달러를 투자할 계획이라고 밝혔어요. 로켓 기지 스타베이스 근처 텍사스 부지는 240억 달러가 들고 자체 전력을 만들어 쓸 예정이에요. 애리조나 단지는 500억 달러가 들며 아직 카운티의 승인이 필요해요. 젊은 클라우드 회사 네비우스도 2027년에 400억 달러를 쓰겠다는 계획을 내놓았어요.

sents.en: SpaceX said on Thursday that it plans to invest $74 billion in new data center campuses in Texas and Arizona.
sents.ko: 스페이스X는 목요일 텍사스와 애리조나에 새 데이터센터 단지를 짓는 데 740억 달러를 투자할 계획이라고 밝혔어요.

paragraphs.en: These plans show how fast the AI boom is raising spending on data centers. SpaceX rents out computing power to AI companies, and it says Anthropic has promised to pay up to $120.5 billion through 2029. Nebius plans to pay for its buildout with customer prepayments and loans backed by customer contracts. That can be risky if projects are late, and its CEO admitted that delays are part of the industry right now. SoftBank also reported a $7.1 billion quarterly loss, and more than half came from power equipment it had ordered.
paragraphs.ko: 이런 계획은 AI 붐이 데이터센터 지출을 얼마나 빠르게 키우는지 보여 줘요. 스페이스X는 AI 기업에 컴퓨팅 자원을 빌려주는데, 앤트로픽이 2029년까지 최대 1205억 달러를 내기로 했다고 해요. 네비우스는 고객이 미리 내는 돈과 고객 계약을 담보로 한 대출로 건설 비용을 대려고 해요. 프로젝트가 늦어지면 위험할 수 있고, 네비우스 CEO도 지금 업계에서는 지연이 흔하다고 인정했어요. 소프트뱅크도 분기 손실 71억 달러를 발표했는데, 절반이 넘는 부분이 주문해 둔 발전 설비에서 나왔어요.

paragraphs.en: Investors are still nervous, and one chip company showed why the mood can change quickly. Cerebras shares jumped about 17 percent after it raised its sales forecast and posted a surprise profit. Reuters says this eased worries about AI spending that grew after the resignation of Nvidia's CEO. Meanwhile, the voters are pushing back, and a Pew Research Center review says people in at least 38 places voted to limit or ban data centers in 2026.
paragraphs.ko: 투자자들은 여전히 불안한데, 한 반도체 회사가 분위기가 빨리 바뀔 수 있음을 보여 줬어요. 세레브라스 주가는 매출 전망을 올리고 깜짝 흑자를 낸 뒤 약 17% 뛰었어요. 로이터는 이것이 엔비디아 CEO 사임 뒤 커졌던 AI 지출 걱정을 누그러뜨렸다고 전해요. 한편 유권자들도 반발하고 있어요. 퓨리서치센터는 2026년 최소 38곳에서 주민들이 데이터센터를 제한하거나 금지하기로 투표했다고 밝혀요.

paragraphs.en: Pew counts more than 3,000 working data centers in the United States, with at least 1,500 more in development. About half or more of adults say data centers are mostly bad for the environment, home energy costs and neighbors' quality of life. The Guardian describes a wooden data center in Sweden that uses only renewable power and was planned with the community in mind. Supporters say the buildings create jobs, but the same Pew review says views on local jobs are more mixed.

issues.title: ICE Reports Record Arrests and Deportations as Trump's Crackdown Faces Political Pressure
issues.gist: ICE says it deported 483,200 people in fiscal year 2026, the most in its history. At the same time, polls show voters are less happy with Trump's immigration crackdown.
issues.gistKo: ICE는 2026 회계연도에 483,200명을 추방해 역대 최다라고 밝혔어요. 한편 여론조사에서는 트럼프의 이민 단속에 대한 유권자 지지가 줄어든 모습이에요.
issues.easyKo: 미국 이민 단속 기관이 올해 가장 많은 사람을 체포하고 내보냈다고 발표했어요. 하지만 지지율은 떨어졌고, 내년 의회는 단속 방식을 조사하겠다고 해요.

views.view: It reports the record numbers and says ICE did not break down how many people had criminal histories.
It links the record to Trump's falling approval on immigration and to Democrats planning to investigate ICE.
DHS presents the year as the best in ICE history and credits the administration's leadership.

why: The government says enforcement is at an all-time high, but the political mood on immigration is turning.
The numbers are hard to compare because reports use different arrest counts.
lines.agree: Reports agree that ICE says it deported 483,200 people, more than in any earlier year.
lines.split: Supporters see success in enforcement, while critics point to falling approval, unclear data and ICE tactics.
lines.life: US immigration politics can change visa and work rules, which matters for Korean students who plan to study or work in the US.
lines.next: Watch how the new Congress handles ICE funding and whether DHS shares details on criminal records.

talk.q: When a government announces record numbers, what else should we check?
talk.qKo: 정부가 기록적인 수치를 발표할 때 또 무엇을 확인해야 할까요?
talk.answer: I would check how the numbers are counted. In this story, two reports gave different arrest totals, and the release did not say how many people had criminal records. Numbers are useful, but they need clear definitions.
talk.answerKo: 저는 수치를 어떻게 세었는지 확인할 거예요. 이 이야기에서도 두 보도가 서로 다른 체포 건수를 전했고, 발표문은 범죄 전력자가 몇 명인지 말하지 않았어요. 수치는 유용하지만 분명한 정의가 필요해요.

paragraphs.en: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, or ICE, said it carried out more arrests and deportations than in any year in its 23-year history. The numbers cover the fiscal year that ended on September 30, 2026. ICE said it deported 483,200 people, up 9 percent from the previous high of 442,640 a year earlier. That is also 78 percent more than the 271,480 deportations in 2024, the last year of Joe Biden's presidency. The agency said arrests were roughly double the number of a year earlier.
paragraphs.ko: 미국 이민세관단속국(ICE)은 23년 역사상 어느 해보다 많은 체포와 추방을 했다고 밝혔어요. 이 수치는 2026년 9월 30일에 끝난 회계연도를 기준으로 해요. ICE는 483,200명을 추방했다고 했고, 이는 1년 전 기록인 442,640명보다 9% 많아요. 조 바이든 대통령 마지막 해인 2024년의 271,480명보다는 78% 많아요. ICE는 체포 건수가 1년 전의 약 두 배라고 했어요.

sents.en: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, or ICE, said it carried out more arrests and deportations than in any year in its 23-year history.
sents.ko: 미국 이민세관단속국(ICE)은 23년 역사상 어느 해보다 많은 체포와 추방을 했다고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: The numbers cover the fiscal year that ended on September 30, 2026.
sents.ko: 이 수치는 2026년 9월 30일에 끝난 회계연도를 기준으로 해요.

sents.en: ICE said it deported 483,200 people, up 9 percent from the previous high of 442,640 a year earlier.
sents.ko: ICE는 483,200명을 추방했다고 했고, 이는 1년 전 기록인 442,640명보다 9% 많아요.

sents.en: That is also 78 percent more than the 271,480 deportations in 2024, the last year of Joe Biden's presidency.
sents.ko: 조 바이든 대통령 마지막 해인 2024년의 271,480명보다는 78% 많아요.

sents.en: The agency said arrests were roughly double the number of a year earlier.
sents.ko: ICE는 체포 건수가 1년 전의 약 두 배라고 했어요.

paragraphs.en: The reports give slightly different arrest counts. The Associated Press, via ABC News, reported 474,850 arrests, while Al Jazeera cited more than 491,000 immigration arrests from the Department of Homeland Security. ICE had not shared such exact counts since President Donald Trump returned to office, and the release does not break down how many people had criminal records.
paragraphs.ko: 보도마다 체포 건수가 조금 달라요. ABC 뉴스가 전한 AP 통신은 체포를 474,850건이라고 했고, 알자지라는 국토안보부 자료로 49만 1천 건이 넘는다고 했어요. ICE는 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 돌아온 뒤 이렇게 정확한 수치를 내지 않았고, 이번 발표도 범죄 전력이 있는 사람이 몇 명인지는 나누어 밝히지 않았어요.

sents.en: The reports give slightly different arrest counts.
sents.ko: 보도마다 체포 건수가 조금 달라요.

sents.en: The Associated Press, via ABC News, reported 474,850 arrests, while Al Jazeera cited more than 491,000 immigration arrests from the Department of Homeland Security.
sents.ko: ABC 뉴스가 전한 AP 통신은 체포를 474,850건이라고 했고, 알자지라는 국토안보부 자료로 49만 1천 건이 넘는다고 했어요.

sents.en: ICE had not shared such exact counts since President Donald Trump returned to office, and the release does not break down how many people had criminal records.

paragraphs.en: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin praised the results and said ICE has been "unleashed" to remove people who are in the country illegally. Steven Camarota of the Center for Immigration Studies said enforcement has clearly grown, and that fear of enforcement may push more people to leave. But he also said it is unclear how many cases were arrests inside the country and how many were people turned around at borders or airports. Mr. Trump recently told CBS that his policy might be "too tough," while also saying he gets high marks for removing "the bad ones."
paragraphs.ko: 마크웨인 멀린 국토안보부 장관은 성과를 칭찬하며 ICE가 불법 체류자를 내보내도록 '풀려났다'고 말했어요. 이민연구센터의 스티븐 카마로타는 단속이 분명히 늘었고, 단속에 대한 두려움 때문에 더 많은 사람이 떠날 수 있다고 말했어요. 하지만 국내 체포가 몇 건이고 국경이나 공항에서 돌려보낸 사람이 몇 명인지는 분명하지 않다고도 했어요. 트럼프는 최근 CBS 인터뷰에서 자신의 정책이 '너무 강할 수 있다'고 하면서도, '나쁜 사람들'을 내보내는 데는 높은 점수를 받는다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: Politics may now change the story. Reuters and Ipsos polling shows Trump's approval on immigration fell to 38 percent from 50 percent at the start of his term. Democrats, who will control Congress next year, say they will investigate ICE tactics and widen paths to legal status. Some Democrats, such as Henry Cuellar, say they want to focus deportations on criminals, while others use harsher words about ICE. For Korean students, this matters because US visa and work rules can change with immigration politics.
paragraphs.ko: 이제 정치가 이야기를 바꿀 수 있어요. 로이터와 입소스 여론조사에 따르면 이민 문제에 대한 트럼프 지지율은 임기 초 50%에서 38%로 떨어졌어요. 내년에 의회를 장악할 민주당은 ICE의 단속 방식을 조사하고 합법적 신분 취득 경로를 넓히겠다고 해요. 헨리 쿠에야르 같은 일부 민주당 의원은 추방을 범죄자에게 집중하길 원하고, 다른 의원들은 ICE에 더 강한 말을 써요. 한국 학생에게도 이 일은 중요한데, 미국 비자와 취업 규칙이 이민 정치에 따라 바뀔 수 있기 때문이에요.

issues.title: High Rates and Inflation Push US Home Sales to a 16-Year Low
issues.gist: US existing home sales fell to a 16-year low in October as mortgage rates stayed high. Strong inflation also raised bets on another Fed rate hike, which hurt bitcoin and lifted the dollar.
issues.gistKo: 높은 주택담보대출 금리 때문에 10월 미국 기존주택 판매가 16년 만의 최저로 떨어졌어요. 강한 물가로 Fed의 추가 금리 인상 예상이 커지며 비트코인은 내리고 달러는 올랐어요.
issues.easyKo: 물가가 잡히지 않아 금리가 오르자 집을 사려는 사람이 크게 줄었어요. 달러와 국채 금리는 오르고 비트코인은 떨어져, 금리 소식이 시장 전체를 흔들고 있어요.

glosses.meaning: 기존주택 판매(새로 짓지 않은 집의 거래)

views.view: It says buyers are driven away by record-high mortgage rates and rising inflation, and the Fed may raise rates again.
It reports that bets on a bigger Fed rate hike pushed up the dollar and US yields this week.
It says inflation fears and expected rate hikes pushed bitcoin below $70,000 for the first time since August.
It says high rates hold buyers back, but pent-up demand could lift sales if rates fall.

why: Inflation stayed strong, so the Fed raised rates and mortgage rates moved up.
Higher borrowing costs scare off buyers, and traders now expect more hikes.
lines.agree: Reports agree that October home sales hit a 16-year low and that high mortgage rates are a main reason.
lines.split: Some experts call it a temporary perfect storm, while others warn that more Fed hikes could keep pressure on markets.
lines.life: Students can use this story to see how inflation, rate hikes and loan costs link together across housing and markets.
lines.next: Watch the Fed's decision next month, the next inflation data and whether mortgage rates start to fall.

talk.q: How do higher interest rates affect big purchases like homes?
talk.qKo: 금리가 오르면 집 같은 큰 구매에 어떤 영향을 줄까요?
talk.answer: In this story, the mortgage rate averaged 7.33 percent, and home sales fell to a 16-year low. I think higher rates make loans more expensive, so many people wait. If rates fall, buyers may return.
talk.answerKo: 이 이야기에서 주택담보대출 금리가 평균 7.33%였고 주택 판매는 16년 만의 최저로 떨어졌어요. 금리가 오르면 대출이 비싸져서 많은 사람이 기다린다고 생각해요. 금리가 내리면 구매자가 돌아올 수 있어요.

phrases.en: home sales fell to a 16-year low

paragraphs.en: US existing home sales fell to a 16-year low in October, according to the National Association of Realtors, or NAR. Sales ran at a yearly pace of 3.75 million homes, down 5.5 percent from September and 8.8 percent from a year earlier. That is the weakest level since August 2010. The median price still rose slightly to $416,700. First-time buyers made up 29 percent of sales, down from 32 percent a year earlier.
paragraphs.ko: 전미부동산중개인협회(NAR)에 따르면 10월 미국 기존주택 판매가 16년 만의 최저로 떨어졌어요. 판매는 연율 375만 채 속도로, 9월보다 5.5%, 1년 전보다 8.8% 줄었어요. 2010년 8월 이후 가장 약한 수준이에요. 중간 가격은 그래도 조금 올라 41만 6,700달러가 됐어요. 생애 첫 주택 구매자는 판매의 29%로, 1년 전 32%에서 줄었어요.

sents.en: US existing home sales fell to a 16-year low in October, according to the National Association of Realtors, or NAR.
sents.ko: 전미부동산중개인협회(NAR)에 따르면 10월 미국 기존주택 판매가 16년 만의 최저로 떨어졌어요.

sents.en: The median price still rose slightly to $416,700.
sents.ko: 중간 가격은 그래도 조금 올라 41만 6,700달러가 됐어요.

sents.en: First-time buyers made up 29 percent of sales, down from 32 percent a year earlier.
sents.ko: 생애 첫 주택 구매자는 판매의 29%로, 1년 전 32%에서 줄었어요.

paragraphs.en: The main cause is the cost of borrowing. NAR says the 30-year mortgage rate averaged 7.33 percent in October, compared with 6.25 percent a year earlier. Inflation has been stronger than expected, so the Federal Reserve raised its rate in September for the first time since 2023. The Guardian says the Fed is ready to raise rates again next month. October core prices, which leave out food and energy, rose 0.3 percent from September and beat forecasts for a third month in a row.
paragraphs.ko: 가장 큰 까닭은 돈을 빌리는 비용이에요. NAR은 10월 30년 만기 주택담보대출 금리가 평균 7.33%로, 1년 전 6.25%였다고 해요. 물가가 예상보다 강해서 연방준비제도(Fed)는 9월에 2023년 이후 처음으로 금리를 올렸어요. 가디언은 Fed가 다음 달 금리를 다시 올릴 태세라고 전해요. 음식과 에너지를 뺀 10월 근원 물가는 9월보다 0.3% 올라 석 달 연속 예상을 웃돌았어요.

sents.en: The main cause is the cost of borrowing.
sents.ko: 가장 큰 까닭은 돈을 빌리는 비용이에요.

sents.en: NAR says the 30-year mortgage rate averaged 7.33 percent in October, compared with 6.25 percent a year earlier.

paragraphs.en: Experts read the slump in different ways. NAR chief economist Lawrence Yun says high rates are holding buyers back, but sales could rise if rates fall. Danielle Hale of Realtor.com says this is not a new normal but a perfect storm of a sudden shift in finance and uncertainty before the election. Markets also feel the pressure, as the dollar stays near 19-month highs and two-year Treasury yields rose about 33 basis points this week to around 4.85 percent. Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time since August as worries about inflation and rate hikes grew.
paragraphs.ko: 전문가들은 이 부진을 서로 다르게 읽어요. NAR 수석 이코노미스트 로런스 윤은 높은 금리가 구매자를 붙잡고 있지만 금리가 내리면 판매가 늘 수 있다고 말해요. 리얼터닷컴의 대니얼 헤일은 이것이 새로운 표준이 아니라 금융 환경의 급변과 선거 전 불확실성이 겹친 상황이라고 말해요. 시장도 압박을 받아서, 달러는 19개월 최고 근처에 머물고 2년 만기 미국 국채 금리는 이번 주 약 33bp 올라 4.85% 안팎이에요. 물가와 금리 인상 걱정이 커지며 비트코인은 8월 이후 처음으로 7만 달러 아래로 떨어졌어요.

sents.en: Experts read the slump in different ways.
sents.ko: 전문가들은 이 부진을 서로 다르게 읽어요.

sents.en: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time since August as worries about inflation and rate hikes grew.
sents.ko: 물가와 금리 인상 걱정이 커지며 비트코인은 8월 이후 처음으로 7만 달러 아래로 떨어졌어요.

paragraphs.en: For Korean students, this story shows how a decision in Washington can reach homes, bonds, currencies and crypto at the same time. It is a clear example of how higher interest rates make a loan more expensive and slow down big purchases. Traders now give a 12.1 percent chance to a larger 50 basis point hike next month, up from zero last week. If you study markets, it helps to follow how one inflation report changes bets on rates.
paragraphs.ko: 한국 대학생에게 이 이야기는 워싱턴의 결정이 집, 채권, 통화, 가상자산에 동시에 닿는 모습을 보여줘요. 금리가 오르면 대출이 비싸지고 큰 구매가 느려지는 것을 보여주는 분명한 예예요. 거래자들은 다음 달 50bp 인상 가능성을 12.1%로 보며, 지난주 0%에서 올랐어요. 시장을 공부한다면 물가 보고서 하나가 금리 예상을 어떻게 바꾸는지 따라가 볼 만해요.

paragraphs.en: Watch the Fed's decision next month and whether it raises rates by 25 or 50 basis points. Also watch November inflation data and the oil price, which depends partly on talks over a deal with Iran. If mortgage rates fall, buyers who waited may come back to the market.

issues.title: US Moves to Seize $1.2 Billion Stolen From Binance and Warns of North Korean Fake Video Calls
issues.gist: The United States says it can seize or hold more than $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance. The FBI also warned about FaceStealer, a fake video-call scheme linked to North Korea.
issues.gistKo: 미국은 바이낸스에서 도난된 가상자산 12억 달러 넘게를 압수하거나 묶어 둘 수 있다고 밝혔어요. FBI는 북한과 연결된 가짜 화상 통화 수법 「페이스스틸러」도 경고했어요.
issues.easyKo: 북한 해커가 거래소 바이낸스에서 큰돈을 훔쳤다고 미국이 밝혔고, 그중 12억 달러 넘게를 붙잡을 수 있게 됐어요. 가짜 화상 통화로 사람을 속이는 새 수법도 알려져서 조심해야 해요.

paragraphs.en: The United States says it has court approval to seize or hold more than $1.2 billion in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance. Binance is the world's largest crypto exchange, and the theft, around October 29, was about $6.3 billion. Reports call it the biggest crypto heist on record. The FBI says a North Korean military hacking group called TraderTraitor did it, and North Korea denies this. US agencies and private firms have frozen more than $2.7 billion of the stolen money.
paragraphs.ko: 미국은 바이낸스에서 도난당한 12억 달러 넘는 가상자산을 압수하거나 묶어 둘 법원 승인을 받았다고 밝혔어요. 바이낸스는 세계 최대 가상자산 거래소이고, 10월 29일 무렵 도난 규모는 약 63억 달러였어요. 보도들은 이것을 기록상 가장 큰 가상자산 도난이라고 불러요. FBI는 트레이더트레이터라는 북한 군 해킹 조직이 저질렀다고 하고, 북한은 이를 부인해요. 미국 기관과 민간 회사들은 도난액 가운데 27억 달러 넘게 동결했어요.

sents.en: The United States says it has court approval to seize or hold more than $1.2 billion in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance.
sents.ko: 미국은 바이낸스에서 도난당한 12억 달러 넘는 가상자산을 압수하거나 묶어 둘 법원 승인을 받았다고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: Binance is the world's largest crypto exchange, and the theft, around October 29, was about $6.3 billion.
sents.ko: 바이낸스는 세계 최대 가상자산 거래소이고, 10월 29일 무렵 도난 규모는 약 63억 달러였어요.

sents.en: Reports call it the biggest crypto heist on record.
sents.ko: 보도들은 이것을 기록상 가장 큰 가상자산 도난이라고 불러요.

sents.en: The FBI says a North Korean military hacking group called TraderTraitor did it, and North Korea denies this.
sents.ko: FBI는 트레이더트레이터라는 북한 군 해킹 조직이 저질렀다고 하고, 북한은 이를 부인해요.

sents.en: US agencies and private firms have frozen more than $2.7 billion of the stolen money.
sents.ko: 미국 기관과 민간 회사들은 도난액 가운데 27억 달러 넘게 동결했어요.

paragraphs.en: On the same day, the FBI also announced a separate scheme called FaceStealer. The FBI says it has led to the theft of more than $400 million over 18 months. Hackers sent video-call invitations from accounts taken from earlier victims. In the call, they played recorded clips of a person the target knew, so the meeting looked real. Then a fake error message offered a link to fix the sound, but the link installed malware. The FBI says it seized more than 900 webcam videos of victims. The BBC adds that the Binance thieves used fake job interviews.
paragraphs.ko: 같은 날 FBI는 따로 벌어진 「페이스스틸러」라는 수법도 발표했어요. FBI는 이 수법으로 18개월 동안 4억 달러 넘게 도난당했다고 해요. 해커들은 앞선 피해자에게서 빼앗은 계정으로 화상 통화 초대를 보냈어요. 통화 중에는 상대가 아는 사람의 녹화 영상을 틀어서 회의가 진짜처럼 보이게 했어요. 그다음 가짜 오류 메시지가 소리를 고치는 링크를 내밀었지만, 그 링크는 악성 프로그램을 깔았어요. FBI는 피해자의 웹캠 영상 900개 넘게 압수했다고 해요. BBC는 바이낸스 도둑들이 가짜 면접을 썼다고 덧붙였어요.

sents.en: On the same day, the FBI also announced a separate scheme called FaceStealer.
sents.ko: 같은 날 FBI는 따로 벌어진 「페이스스틸러」라는 수법도 발표했어요.

sents.en: The FBI says it has led to the theft of more than $400 million over 18 months.

sents.en: The FBI says it seized more than 900 webcam videos of victims.
sents.ko: FBI는 피해자의 웹캠 영상 900개 넘게 압수했다고 해요.

sents.en: The BBC adds that the Binance thieves used fake job interviews.
sents.ko: BBC는 바이낸스 도둑들이 가짜 면접을 썼다고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: US officials say North Korea uses crypto theft to pay for its weapons program. Kim Yo-jong, the sister of leader Kim Jong-un, rejected the FBI's finding and called it a grave political provocation. Binance said it has covered all affected assets using more than $6.34 billion of company money. It also plans to refill its user-protection fund, called SAFU, to about $1 billion. The FBI warned that FaceStealer can fool even careful and experienced computer users. Usually a judge decides who has a rightful claim to recovered funds.
paragraphs.ko: 미국 당국은 북한이 가상자산 절도로 무기 계획에 쓸 돈을 댄다고 말해요. 김정은 위원장의 동생 김여정은 FBI의 결론을 거부하며 심각한 정치적 도발이라고 불렀어요. 바이낸스는 회사 자금 63억 4천만 달러 넘게 써서 피해 자산을 모두 메웠다고 밝혔어요. 또 SAFU라는 이용자 보호 기금을 약 10억 달러로 다시 채울 계획이에요. FBI는 페이스스틸러가 조심스럽고 경험 많은 컴퓨터 사용자도 속일 수 있다고 경고했어요. 보통 되찾은 돈에 정당한 권리가 누구에게 있는지는 판사가 정해요.

sents.en: US officials say North Korea uses crypto theft to pay for its weapons program.
sents.ko: 미국 당국은 북한이 가상자산 절도로 무기 계획에 쓸 돈을 댄다고 말해요.

sents.en: It also plans to refill its user-protection fund, called SAFU, to about $1 billion.
sents.ko: 또 SAFU라는 이용자 보호 기금을 약 10억 달러로 다시 채울 계획이에요.

sents.ko: FBI는 페이스스틸러가 조심스럽고 경험 많은 컴퓨터 사용자도 속일 수 있다고 경고했어요.

sents.en: Usually a judge decides who has a rightful claim to recovered funds.
sents.ko: 보통 되찾은 돈에 정당한 권리가 누구에게 있는지는 판사가 정해요.

paragraphs.en: FaceStealer mostly targets people who work in crypto and web3, and increasingly open-source software developers. Students who code, join hackathons or trade crypto could get such an invitation from a friend's hijacked account. An FBI official warned that people who cannot imagine falling for it are not thinking creatively enough. Korean outlets such as Yonhap and the Korea Herald reported Binance's statement and the link to North Korea.
paragraphs.ko: 페이스스틸러는 주로 가상자산과 웹3 일을 하는 사람, 그리고 갈수록 오픈소스 개발자를 노려요. 코딩하거나 해커톤에 참가하거나 가상자산을 거래하는 학생도 친구의 탈취된 계정에서 이런 초대를 받을 수 있어요. 한 FBI 관계자는 자기가 속을 리 없다고 생각하는 사람은 충분히 창의적으로 생각하지 않는 것이라고 경고했어요. 연합뉴스와 코리아헤럴드 같은 한국 언론은 바이낸스의 발표와 북한 관련성을 보도했어요.

sents.ko: 페이스스틸러는 주로 가상자산과 웹3 일을 하는 사람, 그리고 갈수록 오픈소스 개발자를 노려요.

paragraphs.en: Officials say efforts to trace and freeze the stolen funds are still going on. The hackers keep moving the money through bridges, mixers and exchanges. Watch how much of the rest can be frozen and who gets the recovered money. Also watch whether the FaceStealer takedown slows new fake video calls.
paragraphs.ko: 당국은 도난 자금을 추적하고 동결하는 노력이 계속되고 있다고 해요. 해커들은 브리지, 믹서, 거래소를 거치며 돈을 계속 옮겨요. 나머지 가운데 얼마나 동결되는지, 되찾은 돈을 누가 받는지 지켜보세요. 또 페이스스틸러 단속으로 새 가짜 화상 통화가 줄어드는지도 지켜보세요.

views.view: It says North Korean hackers used fake video calls to steal over $400 million, and that Binance was hit a week earlier.
It says FaceStealer is a separate hacking cluster from the military hackers blamed for the Binance theft.
It reports the FBI seized more than $1.2 billion and that a judge will decide who may claim the funds.
It reports that Binance says it has covered all losses, while Kim Yo-jong rejected the FBI's findings.
It repeats Binance's statement and adds that the State Department sees North Korean cybercrime as a global problem.

heads.title: North Korean hackers used fake video calls in $400m crypto hack, says FBI
US disrupts North Korea's $400 million crypto scam, FBI says
FBI recovers $1.2 billion in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance
Binance says all asset losses from N. Korea-linked cyberattack covered
Binance says all asset losses from N. Korea-linked cyberattack covered

why: North Korea is accused of stealing huge sums in crypto to pay for weapons, and the sum here is a record.
Fake video calls can trick people who work with code and crypto, even careful ones.
lines.agree: Reports agree that about $6.3 billion was stolen from Binance and that more than $1.2 billion is now covered by court approval.
lines.split: The FBI blames North Korea, while North Korea denies it and calls the finding a political provocation.
lines.life: Students who code or trade crypto should be careful about video-call invitations that ask them to click a link to fix a problem.
lines.next: Watch how much of the remaining stolen money is frozen and who is allowed to claim it.

talk.q: How can students protect themselves from fake video-call scams?
talk.qKo: 학생은 가짜 화상 통화 사기로부터 어떻게 자신을 지킬 수 있을까요?
talk.answer: In this story, hackers used fake video calls and a link that installed malware. I think students should never click a link to fix a call, even if a friend seems to be there. They can also check with the friend by another app.
talk.answerKo: 이 이야기에서 해커들은 가짜 화상 통화와 악성 프로그램을 까는 링크를 썼어요. 친구가 있는 것처럼 보여도 통화를 고친다는 링크는 누르지 말아야 한다고 생각해요. 다른 앱으로 친구에게 따로 확인할 수도 있어요.

issues.title: Cade Cunningham Scores 52 in a Historic Double-Overtime Win
issues.gist: Cade Cunningham scored 52 points with 11 assists and no turnovers as the Pistons beat the Wizards 144-140 in double overtime. It was the first 50-point, 10-assist game without a turnover in NBA history, AFP said.
issues.gistKo: 케이드 커닝햄이 52점, 11어시스트, 턴오버 0개로 피스톤스를 이끌어 연장 두 번 끝에 위저즈를 144-140으로 이겼어요. AFP는 NBA 역사상 처음 나온 기록이라고 전했어요.
issues.easyKo: 커닝햄이 52점을 넣고 어시스트도 11개 하면서 실수를 한 번도 하지 않았어요. 연장전을 두 번 치른 끝에 팀이 이겼고, 그 기록이 역사적이라는 평가를 받았어요.

paragraphs.en: Cade Cunningham scored a career-high 52 points as the Detroit Pistons beat the Washington Wizards 144-140 in double overtime. He also had 11 assists and made no turnovers. No NBA player had ever scored 50 points and added 10 assists without a turnover, according to AFP. ESPN said it was the first time since at least 1978.
paragraphs.ko: 케이드 커닝햄이 개인 최다인 52점을 넣어 디트로이트 피스톤스가 워싱턴 위저즈를 연장 두 번 끝에 144-140으로 이겼어요. 그는 어시스트도 11개를 기록했고 턴오버는 하나도 없었어요. AFP에 따르면 NBA에서 턴오버 없이 50점에 10어시스트를 더한 선수는 지금까지 없었어요. ESPN은 적어도 1978년 이후 처음이라고 전했어요.

sents.en: Cade Cunningham scored a career-high 52 points as the Detroit Pistons beat the Washington Wizards 144-140 in double overtime.
sents.ko: 케이드 커닝햄이 개인 최다인 52점을 넣어 디트로이트 피스톤스가 워싱턴 위저즈를 연장 두 번 끝에 144-140으로 이겼어요.

sents.en: He also had 11 assists and made no turnovers.
sents.ko: 그는 어시스트도 11개를 기록했고 턴오버는 하나도 없었어요.

sents.en: No NBA player had ever scored 50 points and added 10 assists without a turnover, according to AFP.
sents.ko: AFP에 따르면 NBA에서 턴오버 없이 50점에 10어시스트를 더한 선수는 지금까지 없었어요.

sents.en: ESPN said it was the first time since at least 1978.
sents.ko: ESPN은 적어도 1978년 이후 처음이라고 전했어요.

paragraphs.en: The game was close all night, with 20 lead changes. Cunningham had only 22 points after three quarters, then scored 18 in the fourth. Trae Young hit a three-pointer at the buzzer to tie the score and force overtime. In the first overtime, Washington scored the first seven points, but Cunningham led a comeback. A rookie, AJ Dybantsa, then tied the game again with less than a second left. In the second overtime, Cunningham hit a three and a fadeaway shot, and Washington could not answer.
paragraphs.ko: 경기는 밤새 팽팽했고 리드가 스무 번 바뀌었어요. 커닝햄은 3쿼터까지 22점뿐이었지만 4쿼터에 18점을 넣었어요. 트레이 영은 경기 종료 버저와 함께 3점슛을 넣어 동점을 만들고 연장전으로 끌고 갔어요. 첫 연장에서 워싱턴이 먼저 7점을 넣었지만 커닝햄이 추격을 이끌었어요. 그때 신인 AJ 디반차가 1초도 안 남기고 다시 동점을 만들었어요. 두 번째 연장에서 커닝햄이 3점슛과 페이드어웨이 슛을 넣었고, 워싱턴은 응수하지 못했어요.

paragraphs.en: Cunningham scored 30 points in the fourth quarter and overtime, the most by a Pistons player in the play-by-play era, which began in 1997-98. His teammate Ausar Thompson had a triple-double with 17 points, 11 assists and 11 rebounds. Thompson said one person cannot guard Cunningham. Cunningham said it was the best he had ever done it in his NBA career. Washington had three players with 30 or more points, but the team lost for the sixth time in a row.
paragraphs.ko: 커닝햄은 4쿼터와 연장에서 30점을 넣었는데, 1997-98시즌부터 시작된 문자 중계 기록 시대를 통틀어 피스톤스 선수로는 가장 많은 수예요. 동료 아우사르 톰슨은 17점, 11어시스트, 11리바운드로 트리플더블을 기록했어요. 톰슨은 한 사람이 커닝햄을 막을 수는 없다고 말했어요. 커닝햄은 NBA 경력에서 가장 잘한 경기였다고 말했어요. 워싱턴은 30점 이상을 넣은 선수가 세 명이었지만 팀은 6연패를 당했어요.

paragraphs.en: For Korean fans who watch the NBA, this is a game people will talk about for a long time. It also shows that a star can be both a scorer and a passer without making mistakes. Students can use the box score to learn how analysts judge efficiency, not only points. Next, watch whether the Pistons keep winning and whether Cunningham stays among the league's top players.
paragraphs.ko: NBA를 보는 한국 팬들에게 이 경기는 오래 이야기될 경기예요. 스타가 실수 없이 득점도 하고 패스도 할 수 있다는 점도 보여 줘요. 학생들은 박스스코어로 분석가들이 득점만이 아니라 효율을 어떻게 평가하는지 배울 수 있어요. 다음으로 피스톤스가 계속 이길지, 커닝햄이 리그 최고 선수군에 남을지 지켜보세요.

views.view: It says Cunningham orchestrated the win and became the first NBA player with 50 points, 10 assists and no turnovers.
It says the Wizards forced extra time, but that only made a great night a historic one for Cunningham.
It repeats the AFP report of a thriller that Detroit held its nerve to win on the road.

Cade authors NBA's first 50-point, 10-assist, 0-turnover game in 2OT thriller
Cunningham scores 52 as Pistons win double-OT thriller against Wizards

why: A star player did something that no NBA player had done before, in a game with two overtimes.
The game was close until the last seconds, so the record came with a real win.
lines.agree: Reports agree that Cunningham scored 52, made no turnovers and led Detroit to a 144-140 win.
lines.life: Students can use the box score to learn how analysts judge a player by efficiency and not only by points.
lines.next: Watch whether the Pistons keep winning and how Cunningham plays in the next games.

issues.title: Darth Vader's Lightsaber Sells for a Star Wars Record
issues.gist: A lightsaber used by Darth Vader in two Star Wars films sold for 4.875 million dollars at auction. The auction house says it is a record for any Star Wars collectible.
issues.gistKo: 다스 베이더가 두 편의 스타워즈 영화에서 쓴 광선검이 경매에서 487만 5천 달러에 팔렸어요. 경매사는 스타워즈 수집품 최고가라고 말해요.
issues.easyKo: 영화에 나온 광선검이 경매에서 487만 5천 달러에 팔렸어요. 스타워즈 수집품 가운데 가장 비싸요. 루크의 광선검이 세운 7월 기록도 넘어섰어요.

paragraphs.en: A lightsaber used by Darth Vader in the Star Wars movies sold for 4.875 million dollars on Thursday. The sale took place at the Ultimate Star Wars Auction held by Heritage Auctions in Dallas. The auction house says it is a world record for any Star Wars collectible. It also beats the record for a prop used on screen, set in July by Luke Skywalker's lightsaber, which sold for 3.75 million dollars.
paragraphs.ko: 스타워즈 영화에서 다스 베이더가 쓴 광선검이 목요일에 487만 5천 달러에 팔렸어요. 판매는 댈러스의 헤리티지 경매사가 연 울티미트 스타워즈 경매에서 이뤄졌어요. 경매사는 스타워즈 수집품 가운데 세계 최고가라고 말해요. 7월에 루크 스카이워커의 광선검이 375만 달러에 팔려 세운 영화 소품 기록도 이번에 깨졌어요.

sents.en: A lightsaber used by Darth Vader in the Star Wars movies sold for 4.875 million dollars on Thursday.
sents.ko: 스타워즈 영화에서 다스 베이더가 쓴 광선검이 목요일에 487만 5천 달러에 팔렸어요.

sents.en: The sale took place at the Ultimate Star Wars Auction held by Heritage Auctions in Dallas.
sents.ko: 판매는 댈러스의 헤리티지 경매사가 연 울티미트 스타워즈 경매에서 이뤄졌어요.

paragraphs.en: Vader used this lightsaber in two famous fights with Luke, in The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi. In the Cloud City duel, Vader tells Luke the famous line, "I am your father." The actors David Prowse and Bob Anderson both held the prop as Vader. The auction house could not confirm whether it was also used in the first Star Wars film from 1977.
paragraphs.ko: 베이더는 이 광선검을 「제국의 역습」과 「제다이의 귀환」 속 루크와의 두 유명한 결투에서 썼어요. 구름 도시 결투에서 베이더는 루크에게 유명한 대사 "내가 네 아버지다"를 말해요. 배우 데이비드 프라우즈와 밥 앤더슨이 베이더 역으로 이 소품을 들었어요. 경매사는 1977년 첫 스타워즈 영화에도 쓰였는지는 확인하지 못했어요.

sents.en: Vader used this lightsaber in two famous fights with Luke, in The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi.

paragraphs.en: The hilt began as a camera flash attachment from the 1950s, made in Britain. Prop makers added black plastic grips and tiny lenses from a calculator display. They also strengthened it so that it could hold wooden blades during fight scenes. The glowing red blade you see on screen was added later by the effects team, who followed the movements of the rods frame by frame. Heritage matched a bend in the hilt and a dent at its base to pictures from the two films.

paragraphs.en: Roger Taylor, the drummer of the British band Duran Duran, said he is leaving the group because of tinnitus. Tinnitus is a condition in which a person hears ringing or other noise that is not really there. Taylor is 66 years old, and he has played with the band since it formed in Birmingham in 1978. He said his tinnitus has been getting steadily worse and that he must now listen to his body and his doctors.

issues.title: Kia Plans a $2 Billion Second Car Plant in India
issues.gist: Kia plans to invest $2 billion in a second plant in Anantapur, India. The plant should start in early 2030 and add 200,000 vehicles a year.
issues.gistKo: 기아가 인도 아난타푸르에 20억 달러를 들여 두 번째 공장을 지을 계획이에요. 2030년 초 가동해 연 20만 대를 더 만들 예정이에요.
issues.easyKo: 기아가 인도에서 차를 더 많이 만들려고 새 공장을 지어요. 인도는 중국과 미국 다음으로 큰 자동차 시장이라 현대차그룹도 투자를 늘리고 있어요.

paragraphs.en: Kia said on Friday that it plans to invest $2 billion in a second car plant in India. Kia India and the government of Andhra Pradesh signed a memorandum of understanding, a written agreement of intent. The new plant will be in Anantapur, where Kia already runs a factory built in 2019.
paragraphs.ko: 기아는 금요일 인도에 두 번째 자동차 공장을 짓는 데 20억 달러를 투자할 계획이라고 밝혔어요. 기아 인디아와 안드라프라데시 주 정부는 의향을 적은 합의서인 양해각서를 맺었어요. 새 공장은 기아가 2019년에 지은 공장을 이미 운영하는 아난타푸르에 들어서요.

sents.en: Kia said on Friday that it plans to invest $2 billion in a second car plant in India.

sents.en: Kia India and the government of Andhra Pradesh signed a memorandum of understanding, a written agreement of intent.
sents.ko: 기아 인디아와 안드라프라데시 주 정부는 의향을 적은 합의서인 양해각서를 맺었어요.

sents.en: The new plant will be in Anantapur, where Kia already runs a factory built in 2019.

paragraphs.en: The new plant should start production in early 2030 and make 200,000 vehicles a year. That would lift Kia's total capacity in India to more than 600,000 vehicles a year. Kia now sells models such as the Seltos, Sonet, Syros, Carens and Carnival in India.

issues.title: Spain Holds Its First General Strike in 14 Years Over Rents and Wages
issues.gist: Spanish unions held a 24-hour general strike over high rents and low pay, the first of its kind in 14 years. It came less than three weeks before a national election.
issues.gistKo: 스페인 노조들이 비싼 월세와 낮은 임금에 항의해 14년 만에 24시간 총파업을 했어요. 전국 선거를 3주도 남기지 않은 때였어요.
issues.easyKo: 스페인에서 집값과 월급 문제 때문에 많은 노동자가 하루 동안 일을 멈췄어요. 수십만 명이 거리 행진에도 참여했고, 일부 도시에서는 충돌도 있었어요.

views.view: It says millions struck over rents and stagnant wages, and the government counted 120,000 marchers in Madrid.
It says the strike keeps housing at the center of the election debate, while PP and Vox call it political.
It lists the unions' demands: pay rises of 4% to 7%, rent limits, and permanent public housing.

why: Rents are rising faster than pay, so housing has become a work issue as well.
The strike came just before a national election, so it also became part of politics.
lines.agree: Reports agree that it was the first general strike in 14 years and that housing costs drove it.
lines.split: Unions say millions took part and the opposition calls the strike political, while the government counted 120,000 marchers in Madrid.
lines.life: Korean students also face high rents and low entry pay, so this shows how workers elsewhere turn them into a public demand.
lines.next: Watch the November 29 election and what the next government does on rents and public housing.

talk.q: Should unions fight for housing costs as well as pay?
talk.qKo: 노조는 임금뿐 아니라 주거비 문제도 위해 싸워야 할까요?
talk.answer: In this story, Spanish workers struck because rents are too high compared with pay. I think housing costs are part of real income, so unions can speak about them. But the best answer should come from talks with employers and governments.
talk.answerKo: 이 이야기에서 스페인 노동자들은 월급에 비해 월세가 너무 높아 파업했어요. 주거비는 실질 소득의 일부라서 노조가 말할 수 있다고 생각해요. 하지만 가장 좋은 답은 고용주와 정부와의 대화에서 나와야 해요.

phrases.en: housing costs are part of real income

paragraphs.en: Spanish workers held a general strike on Wednesday, November 11, for the first time in 14 years. The two biggest unions, CCOO and UGT, called the 24-hour walkout under the slogan wages, housing, prices. Unions said millions of workers joined, and hundreds of thousands of people marched in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, and other cities in the evening. Protesters blocked roads in Madrid, and picket lines appeared outside factories in Catalonia. The government counted 120,000 people at the march in central Madrid.

sents.ko: 정부는 마드리드 중심가 행진에 12만 명이 모였다고 집계했어요.

paragraphs.en: The anger is mainly about housing. The Bank of Spain says the country has 750,000 fewer homes than it needs, and the gap could pass one million by 2028. Al Jazeera cited data that rents average 1,176 euros a month, while a young person earns about 1,190 euros on average. Protests grew after an 87-year-old woman was removed from her home in Madrid in September after her corporate landlord raised the rent. The unions also asked for pay rises of 4% to 7%, limits on rents, and a permanent stock of public housing, according to Idealista.
paragraphs.ko: 분노의 중심에는 주거 문제가 있어요. 스페인 은행은 필요한 것보다 주택이 75만 채 부족하고 격차가 2028년까지 100만 채를 넘을 수 있다고 해요. 알자지라는 월세가 평균 월 1,176유로인데 청년의 평균 월급은 약 1,190유로라는 자료를 인용했어요. 9월 마드리드에서 기업 집주인이 월세를 올린 뒤 87세 여성이 집에서 끌려 나오자 시위가 커졌어요. 이데알리스타에 따르면 노조는 4~7% 임금 인상, 월세 상한, 영구적인 공공주택 확보도 요구했어요.

paragraphs.en: People disagree on what the strike means. The opposition Popular Party and the far-right Vox called the strike political and said it targets them before the election. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez did not openly back the strike, but he praised collective action as the source of workers' rights. An analyst told Al Jazeera that the strike keeps housing at the center of the election debate. In Barcelona, a group of masked protesters broke away after the march, smashed shop windows, and threw fireworks at police, according to local media quoted by the New York Times.
paragraphs.ko: 사람들은 파업의 의미를 두고 의견이 갈려요. 야당인 국민당과 극우 복스는 파업이 정치적이고 선거 전에 자신들을 겨냥한다고 했어요. 페드로 산체스 총리는 파업을 공개적으로 지지하지 않았지만 집단행동이 노동자 권리의 바탕이라고 칭찬했어요. 한 분석가는 알자지라에 파업이 주거 문제를 선거 토론의 중심에 둔다고 말했어요. 뉴욕타임스가 인용한 현지 언론에 따르면 바르셀로나에서는 복면을 쓴 무리가 행진 뒤 떨어져 나와 상점 유리창을 깨고 경찰에 폭죽을 던졌어요.

paragraphs.en: Korean students know this problem well, because rent and low starting pay shape life near many campuses. The story shows how workers can turn a housing crisis into a labor issue. It also shows that a strike can become part of an election campaign.

issues.title: United Airlines Blocks Personal AI Agents From Booking and Managing Flights
issues.gist: United Airlines says it will restrict outside AI agents that try to book flights or manage trips for customers. It cites security risks and federal rules.
issues.gistKo: 유나이티드항공이 고객을 대신해 항공권을 예약하거나 여행을 관리하려는 외부 AI 에이전트를 제한하겠다고 했어요. 보안 위험과 연방 규정을 이유로 들었어요.
issues.easyKo: AI 비서에게 비행기 표 예약을 맡기는 일이 늘고 있는데, 유나이티드항공은 이를 막겠다고 했어요. 계정 정보가 새거나 잘못 결제될 수 있다는 이유예요.

views.view: It reports United cites cybersecurity risks and federal rules, and calls it the latest big US firm to limit AI agents.
It says United bars AI agents because customers who give card details to AI firms could have data exposed.
It quotes a safety expert who calls the restriction reasonable and notes that liability for AI booking talk is unclear.
It says blocks on AI agents are hard for users to read, because bot checks can stop even legitimate agents.

why: AI agents can act with your login, so one error or leak could cost money or miles.
Airlines also want to control how people book, since agents can sit between them and customers.
lines.agree: Reports agree that United will restrict third-party AI agents and cites security and rule risks.
lines.split: Some see a reasonable safety step, while others may see an airline guarding control of its customers.
lines.life: Students who book cheap flights with AI tools should keep passwords private and use the airline's own app or site.
lines.next: Watch the details of United's policy and whether other airlines follow or sign deals with AI firms.

talk.answer: In this story, United says AI agents can expose account details and cause unintended purchases. I would use AI to find ideas, but I would book the trip myself. It is safer to keep passwords private.

paragraphs.en: United Airlines said it will restrict AI agents that book flights and manage reservations for customers. An AI agent is a program that acts on a user's behalf, often after the user shares a login. The airline said the limits apply directly on its own digital platforms and indirectly through travel agencies and aggregators. United said it is updating its booking, ticketing, and distribution policies. The news was reported on November 12.
paragraphs.ko: 유나이티드항공은 고객을 대신해 항공권을 예약하고 예약을 관리하는 AI 에이전트를 제한하겠다고 했어요. AI 에이전트는 사용자가 로그인 정보를 알려 준 뒤 그를 대신해 움직이는 프로그램이에요. 항공사는 이 제한이 자사 디지털 플랫폼에서 직접, 그리고 여행사와 취합 사이트를 통해 간접적으로 적용된다고 했어요. 유나이티드는 예약, 발권, 유통 정책을 고치고 있다고 했어요. 이 소식은 11월 12일에 보도됐어요.

paragraphs.en: United gave two main reasons. First, sharing account details with a third-party AI tool can expose sensitive information. The airline also warned that such tools may cause unintended purchases, account changes, or use of MileagePlus miles. Second, United said federal aviation rules require a human to finish check-in and confirm that bags hold no banned items. TechCrunch noted that banks, including Bank of America, recently told customers not to share passwords with AI assistants.
paragraphs.ko: 유나이티드는 두 가지 주요 이유를 들었어요. 첫째, 계정 정보를 외부 AI 도구와 나누면 민감한 정보가 드러날 수 있어요. 항공사는 이런 도구가 의도하지 않은 구매, 계정 변경, 마일리지플러스 마일 사용을 일으킬 수 있다고도 경고했어요. 둘째, 유나이티드는 연방 항공 규정이 사람이 체크인을 끝내고 가방에 금지 물품이 없음을 확인하도록 요구한다고 했어요. 테크크런치는 뱅크오브아메리카 등 은행들도 최근 고객에게 AI 비서와 비밀번호를 나누지 말라고 했다고 짚었어요.

paragraphs.en: Experts and outlets see the move in different ways. An aviation safety expert told The Epoch Times it is a reasonable move while the industry deals with these risks. He also said an AI agent may make statements during booking that a passenger later disputes, which makes it unclear who is responsible. TechCrunch called United the latest big American company to stop customers from using AI agents on its systems. Earlier, TechCrunch reported that United pointed to its terms of use, which ban robots and automated processes without written permission.
paragraphs.ko: 전문가와 언론은 이 조치를 다르게 봐요. 한 항공 안전 전문가는 업계가 이런 위험을 다루는 동안 합리적인 조치라고 에포크타임스에 말했어요. 그는 AI 에이전트가 예약 중 한 말을 승객이 나중에 부인할 수 있어 책임이 누구에게 있는지 불분명해진다고도 했어요. 테크크런치는 유나이티드를 고객이 자사 시스템에서 AI 에이전트를 쓰지 못하게 막은 최신 미국 대기업이라고 불렀어요. 앞서 테크크런치는 유나이티드가 서면 허락 없는 로봇과 자동화 절차를 금지하는 이용 약관을 언급했다고 보도했어요.

sents.en: An aviation safety expert told The Epoch Times it is a reasonable move while the industry deals with these risks.

sents.en: He also said an AI agent may make statements during booking that a passenger later disputes, which makes it unclear who is responsible.
sents.ko: 그는 AI 에이전트가 예약 중 한 말을 승객이 나중에 부인할 수 있어 책임이 누구에게 있는지 불분명해진다고도 했어요.

sents.en: TechCrunch called United the latest big American company to stop customers from using AI agents on its systems.
sents.ko: 테크크런치는 유나이티드를 고객이 자사 시스템에서 AI 에이전트를 쓰지 못하게 막은 최신 미국 대기업이라고 불렀어요.

sents.en: Earlier, TechCrunch reported that United pointed to its terms of use, which ban robots and automated processes without written permission.
sents.ko: 앞서 테크크런치는 유나이티드가 서면 허락 없는 로봇과 자동화 절차를 금지하는 이용 약관을 언급했다고 보도했어요.

paragraphs.en: This matters for students because many people now use AI helpers for travel, shopping, and bank tasks. The Epoch Times said customers can still use AI tools for general ideas, such as places to visit at a certain time of year. But travelers should not give an AI tool their MileagePlus number, password, or sign-in details. Korean students who plan exchange trips or low-cost flights should also be careful with passwords.
paragraphs.ko: 많은 사람이 이제 여행, 쇼핑, 은행 업무에 AI 도우미를 쓰기 때문에 학생에게도 중요해요. 에포크타임스는 고객이 특정 시기에 갈 만한 곳 같은 일반적인 아이디어에는 여전히 AI 도구를 쓸 수 있다고 했어요. 하지만 여행자는 AI 도구에 마일리지플러스 번호나 비밀번호, 로그인 정보를 주면 안 돼요. 교환학생이나 저가 항공권을 알아보는 한국 학생도 비밀번호를 조심해야 해요.

paragraphs.en: Other companies are also deciding how to treat AI agents. Some firms may block them, while others may sign deals to let trusted agents in. Watch whether United explains exactly which AI actions are allowed and when the policy starts.

issues.title: Arsenal Hold Barcelona to a 1-1 Draw in the Women's Champions League
issues.gist: Arsenal drew 1-1 with Barcelona at the Camp Nou in the Women's Champions League. The draw ended Barcelona's perfect record this season.
issues.gistKo: 아스널이 여자 챔피언스리그에서 캄프 누 원정으로 바르셀로나와 1대1로 비겼어요. 이 무승부로 바르셀로나의 이번 시즌 전승 기록이 끝났어요.
issues.easyKo: 아스널 여자팀이 챔피언 바르셀로나를 상대로 끈질기게 버텨 승점을 땄어요. 바르셀로나가 슈팅은 훨씬 많았지만 한 골밖에 넣지 못했어요.

paragraphs.en: Arsenal drew 1-1 with Barcelona at the Camp Nou in the Women's Champions League on Thursday. Frida Maanum put Arsenal ahead in the first half, even though Barcelona had the ball most of the time. Caroline Graham Hansen equalised after the break, soon after Aitana Bonmati came on. The draw ended Barcelona's perfect record in this season's Champions League.
paragraphs.ko: 아스널은 목요일 여자 챔피언스리그에서 캄프 누에 원정을 가 바르셀로나와 1대1로 비겼어요. 바르셀로나가 대부분 공을 가졌는데도 프리다 마눔이 전반에 아스널을 앞서게 했어요. 후반에 아이타나 본마티가 들어온 직후 카롤린 그레이엄 한센이 동점골을 넣었어요. 이 무승부로 바르셀로나의 이번 시즌 챔피언스리그 전승 기록이 끝났어요.

sents.en: Arsenal drew 1-1 with Barcelona at the Camp Nou in the Women's Champions League on Thursday.
sents.ko: 아스널은 목요일 여자 챔피언스리그에서 캄프 누에 원정을 가 바르셀로나와 1대1로 비겼어요.

sents.en: Frida Maanum put Arsenal ahead in the first half, even though Barcelona had the ball most of the time.
sents.ko: 바르셀로나가 대부분 공을 가졌는데도 프리다 마눔이 전반에 아스널을 앞서게 했어요.

sents.en: Caroline Graham Hansen equalised after the break, soon after Aitana Bonmati came on.
sents.ko: 후반에 아이타나 본마티가 들어온 직후 카롤린 그레이엄 한센이 동점골을 넣었어요.

paragraphs.en: Barcelona had almost 70% of the ball, 24 shots and 11 corners, but they scored only once. Arsenal defended deep and used a few good chances, which is very different from how they usually play. Defender Steph Catley made five interceptions and nine clearances to stop Barcelona. Coach Renee Slegers praised the grit and bravery of her team. These two teams also met in the 2025 final in Lisbon, where Arsenal won 1-0.
paragraphs.ko: 바르셀로나는 공 점유율이 70%에 가까웠고 슈팅 24개, 코너킥 11개를 얻었지만 한 골에 그쳤어요. 아스널은 깊게 수비하며 몇 번의 좋은 기회를 살렸는데, 평소 경기 방식과는 아주 달랐어요. 수비수 스텝 캐틀리는 가로채기 다섯 번과 걷어내기 아홉 번으로 바르셀로나를 막았어요. 르네 슬레헤르스 감독은 선수들의 끈기와 용기를 칭찬했어요. 두 팀은 2025년 리스본 결승에서도 만났고 그때는 아스널이 1대0으로 이겼어요.

sents.en: Barcelona had almost 70% of the ball, 24 shots and 11 corners, but they scored only once.

paragraphs.en: Writers saw the result in different ways. BBC Sport called it a gritty show and said it was a big boost for a team that is struggling for form. The Guardian said Arsenal dug deep and showed they can play ugly when needed. ESPN was more careful and said the result shows Barcelona's waste more than Arsenal's quality. It also said Arsenal's season is still full of ups and downs.
paragraphs.ko: 기자들은 이 결과를 서로 다르게 봤어요. BBC 스포츠는 끈질긴 경기였고, 부진한 팀에 큰 힘이 된다고 했어요. 가디언은 아스널이 끈질기게 버텼고 필요하면 투박하게도 싸울 수 있음을 보였다고 했어요. ESPN은 더 조심스러워서, 이 결과가 아스널의 실력보다 바르셀로나의 아쉬운 결정력을 보여준다고 했어요. 또 아스널의 이번 시즌이 아직 기복이 심하다고 했어요.

sents.ko: 또 아스널의 이번 시즌이 아직 기복이 심하다고 했어요.

paragraphs.en: For students, this match is a good example of how a weaker side can still get a result. Arsenal are sixth in the Women's Super League, 12 points behind Manchester City, yet they held the European champions. Clear roles, hard work and patience helped the team more than star power. Many group projects work the same way.
paragraphs.ko: 학생들에게 이 경기는 약한 팀도 결과를 낼 수 있는 좋은 예예요. 아스널은 여자 슈퍼리그 6위로 맨체스터 시티에 승점 12점 뒤지지만 유럽 챔피언을 막아 냈어요. 뚜렷한 역할, 노력, 인내가 스타의 힘보다 팀에 더 도움이 됐어요. 많은 모둠 과제도 같은 방식이에요.

paragraphs.en: Arsenal have seven points from four games and now face London City Lionesses on Sunday. Next Thursday they host Lyon in London, and in December they end the group phase at Inter Milan. Barcelona must become more clinical if they want to keep the trophy.

issues.title: Google Adds Gemini 4 Hydrogen to Search for Harder Questions
issues.gist: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen and added it to Search, calling it the biggest model upgrade to Search yet. It is meant to handle complex questions and typos better.
issues.gistKo: 구글이 제미나이 4 하이드로젠을 내놓고 검색에 넣었고, 검색에 들어간 가장 큰 모델 개선이라고 해요. 복잡한 질문과 오타를 더 잘 다루도록 만들어졌어요.
issues.easyKo: 구글 검색에 새 AI 모델이 들어가서 길고 복잡한 질문, 오타가 있는 질문에도 더 잘 답해요. 이미지와 표 같은 시각 자료도 더 많이 나와요.

views.view: It says Hydrogen is a fast, cheaper model that Google claims beats a stronger model on one test.
It says the model is the new default in AI Mode and adds more visuals, links and thinking levels.

heads.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions

why: Search is a tool many students use daily, so a better model changes everyday searching.
It also shows companies using smaller, faster models for common tasks.
lines.agree: Reports agree that Hydrogen is rolling out in Google Search and handles complex questions and typos better.
lines.life: Students can ask longer, multi-part questions in Search, but should still check key facts on the linked sites.
lines.next: Watch whether independent tests confirm Google's speed and quality claims.

quiz.qKo: 제미나이 4 하이드로젠은 검색에서 무엇을 하도록 만들어졌나요?
choices: Show only text answers without images
